3| *            implemented on top of the SAX interfaces

5| * References:

427|/**
428| * xmlParserEntityCheck:
429| * @ctxt:  parser context
430| * @extra:  sum of unexpanded entity sizes
431| *
432| * Check for non-linear entity expansion behaviour.
433| *
434| * In some cases like xmlExpandEntityInAttValue, this function is called
435| * for each, possibly nested entity and its unexpanded content length.
436| *
437| * In other cases like xmlParseReference, it's only called for each
438| * top-level entity with its unexpanded content length plus the sum of
439| * the unexpanded content lengths (plus fixed cost) of all nested
440| * entities.
441| *
442| * Summing the unexpanded lengths also adds the length of the reference.
443| * This is by design. Taking the length of the entity name into account
444| * discourages attacks that try to waste CPU time with abusively long
445| * entity names. See test/recurse/lol6.xml for example. Each call also
446| * adds some fixed cost XML_ENT_FIXED_COST to discourage attacks with
447| * short entities.
448| *
449| * Returns 1 on error, 0 on success.
450| */
451|static int
452|xmlParserEntityCheck(xmlParserCtxtPtr ctxt, unsigned long extra)
453|{
454|    unsigned long consumed;
455|    unsigned long *expandedSize;
456|    xmlParserInputPtr input = ctxt->input;
457|    xmlEntityPtr entity = input->entity;
458|
459|    if ((entity) && (entity->flags & XML_ENT_CHECKED))
460|        return(0);
461|
462|    /*
463|     * Compute total consumed bytes so far, including input streams of
464|     * external entities.
465|     */
466|    consumed = input->consumed;
467|    xmlSaturatedAddSizeT(&consumed, input->cur - input->base);
468|    xmlSaturatedAdd(&consumed, ctxt->sizeentities);

723|typedef struct {
724|    xmlChar *mem;
725|    unsigned size;
726|    unsigned cap; /* size < cap */
727|    unsigned max; /* size <= max */

731|static void
732|xmlSBufInit(xmlSBuf *buf, unsigned max) {
733|    buf->mem = NULL;
734|    buf->size = 0;
735|    buf->cap = 0;
736|    buf->max = max;
737|    buf->code = XML_ERR_OK;

739|
740|static int
741|xmlSBufGrow(xmlSBuf *buf, unsigned len) {
742|    xmlChar *mem;
743|    unsigned cap;
744|
745|    if (len >= UINT_MAX / 2 - buf->size) {
746|        buf->code = XML_ERR_RESOURCE_LIMIT;
747|        return(-1);
748|    }
749|
750|    cap = (buf->size + len) * 2;
751|    if (cap < 240)
752|        cap = 240;
753|
754|    mem = xmlRealloc(buf->mem, cap);
755|    if (mem == NULL) {
756|        buf->code = XML_ERR_NO_MEMORY;
757|        return(-1);
758|    }
759|
760|    buf->mem = mem;
761|    buf->cap = cap;
762|
763|    return(0);
764|}
765|
766|static void
767|xmlSBufAddString(xmlSBuf *buf, const xmlChar *str, unsigned len) {
768|    if (buf->max - buf->size < len) {
769|        buf->code = XML_ERR_RESOURCE_LIMIT;
770|        return;
771|    }
772|
773|    if (buf->cap - buf->size <= len) {
774|        if (xmlSBufGrow(buf, len) < 0)
775|            return;
776|    }
777|
778|    if (len > 0)
779|        memcpy(buf->mem + buf->size, str, len);
780|    buf->size += len;
781|}
782|
783|static void
784|xmlSBufAddCString(xmlSBuf *buf, const char *str, unsigned len) {
785|    xmlSBufAddString(buf, (const xmlChar *) str, len);

788|static void
789|xmlSBufAddChar(xmlSBuf *buf, int c) {
790|    xmlChar *end;
791|
792|    if (buf->max - buf->size < 4) {
793|        buf->code = XML_ERR_RESOURCE_LIMIT;
794|        return;
795|    }
796|
797|    if (buf->cap - buf->size <= 4) {
798|        if (xmlSBufGrow(buf, 4) < 0)
799|            return;
800|    }
801|
802|    end = buf->mem + buf->size;
803|
804|    if (c < 0x80) {
805|        *end = (xmlChar) c;
806|        buf->size += 1;
807|    } else {
808|        buf->size += xmlCopyCharMultiByte(end, c);
809|    }

825|static xmlChar *
826|xmlSBufFinish(xmlSBuf *buf, int *sizeOut, xmlParserCtxtPtr ctxt,
827|              const char *errMsg) {
828|    if (buf->mem == NULL) {

830|        if (buf->mem == NULL) {

832|        } else {

862|static int
863|xmlUTF8MultibyteLen(xmlParserCtxtPtr ctxt, const xmlChar *str,
864|                    const char *errMsg) {
865|    int c = str[0];
866|    int c1 = str[1];
867|
868|    if ((c1 & 0xC0) != 0x80)
869|        goto encoding_error;
870|
871|    if (c < 0xE0) {
872|        /* 2-byte sequence */
873|        if (c < 0xC2)
874|            goto encoding_error;
875|
876|        return(2);
877|    } else {
878|        int c2 = str[2];
879|
880|        if ((c2 & 0xC0) != 0x80)
881|            goto encoding_error;
882|
883|        if (c < 0xF0) {
884|            /* 3-byte sequence */
885|            if (c == 0xE0) {
886|                /* overlong */
887|                if (c1 < 0xA0)
888|                    goto encoding_error;
889|            } else if (c == 0xED) {
890|                /* surrogate */
891|                if (c1 >= 0xA0)
892|                    goto encoding_error;
893|            } else if (c == 0xEF) {
894|                /* U+FFFE and U+FFFF are invalid Chars */
895|                if ((c1 == 0xBF) && (c2 >= 0xBE))
896|                    xmlFatalErrMsg(ctxt, XML_ERR_INVALID_CHAR, errMsg);
897|            }
898|
899|            return(3);
900|        } else {
901|            /* 4-byte sequence */
902|            if ((str[3] & 0xC0) != 0x80)
903|                goto encoding_error;
904|            if (c == 0xF0) {
905|                /* overlong */
906|                if (c1 < 0x90)
907|                    goto encoding_error;
908|            } else if (c >= 0xF4) {
909|                /* greater than 0x10FFFF */
910|                if ((c > 0xF4) || (c1 >= 0x90))
911|                    goto encoding_error;
912|            }
913|
914|            return(4);
915|        }
916|    }
917|
918|encoding_error:
919|    /* Only report the first error */
920|    if ((ctxt->input->flags & XML_INPUT_ENCODING_ERROR) == 0) {
921|        xmlCtxtErrIO(ctxt, XML_ERR_INVALID_ENCODING, NULL);
922|        ctxt->input->flags |= XML_INPUT_ENCODING_ERROR;
923|    }
924|
925|    return(0);

1007|/**

1009| * @src: the source string
1010| * @dst: the target string
1011| *
1012| * Normalize the space in non CDATA attribute values:
1013| * If the attribute type is not CDATA, then the XML processor MUST further
1014| * process the normalized attribute value by discarding any leading and
1015| * trailing space (#x20) characters, and by replacing sequences of space
1016| * (#x20) characters by a single space (#x20) character.
1017| * Note that the size of dst need to be at least src, and if one doesn't need
1018| * to preserve dst (and it doesn't come from a dictionary or read-only) then
1019| * passing src as dst is just fine.

1022| *         is needed.

1025|xmlAttrNormalizeSpace(const xmlChar *src, xmlChar *dst)
1026|{
1027|    if ((src == NULL) || (dst == NULL))
1028|        return(NULL);
1029|
1030|    while (*src == 0x20) src++;
1031|    while (*src != 0) {
1032|	if (*src == 0x20) {
1033|	    while (*src == 0x20) src++;
1034|	    if (*src != 0)
1035|		*dst++ = 0x20;
1036|	} else {
1037|	    *dst++ = *src++;
1038|	}
1039|    }
1040|    *dst = 0;
1041|    if (dst == src)
1042|       return(NULL);
1043|    return(dst);

1260| *                 ["-" region]
1261| *                 *("-" variant)
1262| *                 *("-" extension)
1263| *                 ["-" privateuse]

1288| *               / %x61-77             ; a - w

2418|             * Expand parameter entity. We continue to consume
2419|             * whitespace at the start of the entity and possible

2421|             * even pop multiple PEs in this loop.

5447| * xmlParsePI:
5448| * @ctxt:  an XML parser context
5449| *
5450| * DEPRECATED: Internal function, don't use.
5451| *
5452| * parse an XML Processing Instruction.
5453| *
5454| * [16] PI ::= '<?' PITarget (S (Char* - (Char* '?>' Char*)))? '?>'
5455| *
5456| * The processing is transferred to SAX once parsed.
5457| */

5459|void
5460|xmlParsePI(xmlParserCtxtPtr ctxt) {

5462|    size_t len = 0;
5463|    size_t size = XML_PARSER_BUFFER_SIZE;
5464|    size_t maxLength = (ctxt->options & XML_PARSE_HUGE) ?
5465|                       XML_MAX_HUGE_LENGTH :
5466|                       XML_MAX_TEXT_LENGTH;
5467|    int cur, l;
5468|    const xmlChar *target;
5469|
5470|    if ((RAW == '<') && (NXT(1) == '?')) {
5471|	/*
5472|	 * this is a Processing Instruction.
5473|	 */
5474|	SKIP(2);
5475|
5476|	/*
5477|	 * Parse the target name and check for special support like
5478|	 * namespace.
5479|	 */
5480|        target = xmlParsePITarget(ctxt);
5481|	if (target != NULL) {
5482|	    if ((RAW == '?') && (NXT(1) == '>')) {
5483|		SKIP(2);
5484|
5485|		/*
5486|		 * SAX: PI detected.
5487|		 */
5488|		if ((ctxt->sax) && (!ctxt->disableSAX) &&
5489|		    (ctxt->sax->processingInstruction != NULL))
5490|		    ctxt->sax->processingInstruction(ctxt->userData,
5491|		                                     target, NULL);
5492|		return;
5493|	    }
5494|	    buf = (xmlChar *) xmlMallocAtomic(size);
5495|	    if (buf == NULL) {
5496|		xmlErrMemory(ctxt);
5497|		return;
5498|	    }
5499|	    if (SKIP_BLANKS == 0) {
5500|		xmlFatalErrMsgStr(ctxt, XML_ERR_SPACE_REQUIRED,
5501|			  "ParsePI: PI %s space expected\n", target);
5502|	    }
5503|	    cur = CUR_CHAR(l);
5504|	    while (IS_CHAR(cur) && /* checked */
5505|		   ((cur != '?') || (NXT(1) != '>'))) {
5506|		if (len + 5 >= size) {
5507|		    xmlChar *tmp;
5508|                    size_t new_size = size * 2;
5509|		    tmp = (xmlChar *) xmlRealloc(buf, new_size);
5510|		    if (tmp == NULL) {
5511|			xmlErrMemory(ctxt);
5512|			xmlFree(buf);
5513|			return;
5514|		    }
5515|		    buf = tmp;
5516|                    size = new_size;
5517|		}
5518|		COPY_BUF(buf, len, cur);
5519|                if (len > maxLength) {
5520|                    xmlFatalErrMsgStr(ctxt, XML_ERR_PI_NOT_FINISHED,
5521|                                      "PI %s too big found", target);
5522|                    xmlFree(buf);
5523|                    return;
5524|                }
5525|		NEXTL(l);
5526|		cur = CUR_CHAR(l);
5527|	    }
5528|	    buf[len] = 0;
5529|	    if (cur != '?') {
5530|		xmlFatalErrMsgStr(ctxt, XML_ERR_PI_NOT_FINISHED,
5531|		      "ParsePI: PI %s never end ...\n", target);
5532|	    } else {
5533|		SKIP(2);
5534|
5535|#ifdef LIBXML_CATALOG_ENABLED
5536|		if ((ctxt->inSubset == 0) &&
5537|		    (xmlStrEqual(target, XML_CATALOG_PI))) {
5538|		    xmlCatalogAllow allow = xmlCatalogGetDefaults();
5539|		    if ((allow == XML_CATA_ALLOW_DOCUMENT) ||
5540|			(allow == XML_CATA_ALLOW_ALL))
5541|			xmlParseCatalogPI(ctxt, buf);
5542|		}
5543|#endif
5544|
5545|
5546|		/*
5547|		 * SAX: PI detected.
5548|		 */
5549|		if ((ctxt->sax) && (!ctxt->disableSAX) &&
5550|		    (ctxt->sax->processingInstruction != NULL))
5551|		    ctxt->sax->processingInstruction(ctxt->userData,
5552|		                                     target, buf);
5553|	    }
5554|	    xmlFree(buf);
5555|	} else {
5556|	    xmlFatalErr(ctxt, XML_ERR_PI_NOT_STARTED, NULL);
5557|	}
5558|    }

6157|/**
6158| * xmlParseAttributeType:
6159| * @ctxt:  an XML parser context
6160| * @tree:  the enumeration tree built while parsing
6161| *
6162| * DEPRECATED: Internal function, don't use.
6163| *
6164| * parse the Attribute list def for an element
6165| *
6166| * [54] AttType ::= StringType | TokenizedType | EnumeratedType
6167| *
6168| * [55] StringType ::= 'CDATA'
6169| *
6170| * [56] TokenizedType ::= 'ID' | 'IDREF' | 'IDREFS' | 'ENTITY' |
6171| *                        'ENTITIES' | 'NMTOKEN' | 'NMTOKENS'
6172| *
6173| * Validity constraints for attribute values syntax are checked in
6174| * xmlValidateAttributeValue()
6175| *
6176| * [ VC: ID ]
6177| * Values of type ID must match the Name production. A name must not
6178| * appear more than once in an XML document as a value of this type;
6179| * i.e., ID values must uniquely identify the elements which bear them.
6180| *
6181| * [ VC: One ID per Element Type ]
6182| * No element type may have more than one ID attribute specified.
6183| *
6184| * [ VC: ID Attribute Default ]
6185| * An ID attribute must have a declared default of #IMPLIED or #REQUIRED.
6186| *
6187| * [ VC: IDREF ]
6188| * Values of type IDREF must match the Name production, and values
6189| * of type IDREFS must match Names; each IDREF Name must match the value
6190| * of an ID attribute on some element in the XML document; i.e. IDREF
6191| * values must match the value of some ID attribute.
6192| *
6193| * [ VC: Entity Name ]
6194| * Values of type ENTITY must match the Name production, values
6195| * of type ENTITIES must match Names; each Entity Name must match the
6196| * name of an unparsed entity declared in the DTD.
6197| *
6198| * [ VC: Name Token ]
6199| * Values of type NMTOKEN must match the Nmtoken production; values
6200| * of type NMTOKENS must match Nmtokens.
6201| *
6202| * Returns the attribute type
6203| */
6204|int
6205|xmlParseAttributeType(xmlParserCtxtPtr ctxt, xmlEnumerationPtr *tree) {
6206|    if (CMP5(CUR_PTR, 'C', 'D', 'A', 'T', 'A')) {
6207|	SKIP(5);
6208|	return(XML_ATTRIBUTE_CDATA);
6209|     } else if (CMP6(CUR_PTR, 'I', 'D', 'R', 'E', 'F', 'S')) {
6210|	SKIP(6);
6211|	return(XML_ATTRIBUTE_IDREFS);
6212|     } else if (CMP5(CUR_PTR, 'I', 'D', 'R', 'E', 'F')) {
6213|	SKIP(5);
6214|	return(XML_ATTRIBUTE_IDREF);
6215|     } else if ((RAW == 'I') && (NXT(1) == 'D')) {
6216|        SKIP(2);
6217|	return(XML_ATTRIBUTE_ID);
6218|     } else if (CMP6(CUR_PTR, 'E', 'N', 'T', 'I', 'T', 'Y')) {
6219|	SKIP(6);
6220|	return(XML_ATTRIBUTE_ENTITY);
6221|     } else if (CMP8(CUR_PTR, 'E', 'N', 'T', 'I', 'T', 'I', 'E', 'S')) {
6222|	SKIP(8);
6223|	return(XML_ATTRIBUTE_ENTITIES);
6224|     } else if (CMP8(CUR_PTR, 'N', 'M', 'T', 'O', 'K', 'E', 'N', 'S')) {
6225|	SKIP(8);
6226|	return(XML_ATTRIBUTE_NMTOKENS);
6227|     } else if (CMP7(CUR_PTR, 'N', 'M', 'T', 'O', 'K', 'E', 'N')) {
6228|	SKIP(7);
6229|	return(XML_ATTRIBUTE_NMTOKEN);
6230|     }
6231|     return(xmlParseEnumeratedType(ctxt, tree));

6495| *	opening or closing parentheses in a choice, seq, or Mixed
6496| *	construct is contained in the replacement text for a parameter
6497| *	entity, both must be contained in the same replacement text. For
6498| *	interoperability, if a parameter-entity reference appears in a
6499| *	choice, seq, or Mixed construct, its replacement text should not
6500| *	be empty, and neither the first nor last non-blank character of
6501| *	the replacement text should be a connector (| or ,).

6527|	SKIP_BLANKS_PE;

6975| *
6976| * Parse a conditional section. Always consumes '<!['.
6977| *
6978| * [61] conditionalSect ::= includeSect | ignoreSect
6979| * [62] includeSect ::= '<![' S? 'INCLUDE' S? '[' extSubsetDecl ']]>'
6980| * [63] ignoreSect ::= '<![' S? 'IGNORE' S? '[' ignoreSectContents* ']]>'
6981| * [64] ignoreSectContents ::= Ignore ('<![' ignoreSectContents ']]>' Ignore)*

6985|static void
6986|xmlParseConditionalSections(xmlParserCtxtPtr ctxt) {
6987|    int *inputIds = NULL;
6988|    size_t inputIdsSize = 0;
6989|    size_t depth = 0;
6990|
6991|    while (PARSER_STOPPED(ctxt) == 0) {
6992|        if ((RAW == '<') && (NXT(1) == '!') && (NXT(2) == '[')) {
6993|            int id = ctxt->input->id;
6994|
6995|            SKIP(3);
6996|            SKIP_BLANKS_PE;
6997|
6998|            if (CMP7(CUR_PTR, 'I', 'N', 'C', 'L', 'U', 'D', 'E')) {
6999|                SKIP(7);
7000|                SKIP_BLANKS_PE;
7001|                if (RAW != '[') {
7002|                    xmlFatalErr(ctxt, XML_ERR_CONDSEC_INVALID, NULL);
7003|                    xmlHaltParser(ctxt);
7004|                    goto error;
7005|                }
7006|                if (ctxt->input->id != id) {
7007|                    xmlFatalErrMsg(ctxt, XML_ERR_ENTITY_BOUNDARY,
7008|                                   "All markup of the conditional section is"
7009|                                   " not in the same entity\n");
7010|                }
7011|                NEXT;
7012|
7013|                if (inputIdsSize <= depth) {
7014|                    int *tmp;
7015|
7016|                    inputIdsSize = (inputIdsSize == 0 ? 4 : inputIdsSize * 2);
7017|                    tmp = (int *) xmlRealloc(inputIds,
7018|                            inputIdsSize * sizeof(int));
7019|                    if (tmp == NULL) {
7020|                        xmlErrMemory(ctxt);
7021|                        goto error;
7022|                    }
7023|                    inputIds = tmp;
7024|                }
7025|                inputIds[depth] = id;
7026|                depth++;
7027|            } else if (CMP6(CUR_PTR, 'I', 'G', 'N', 'O', 'R', 'E')) {
7028|                size_t ignoreDepth = 0;
7029|
7030|                SKIP(6);
7031|                SKIP_BLANKS_PE;
7032|                if (RAW != '[') {
7033|                    xmlFatalErr(ctxt, XML_ERR_CONDSEC_INVALID, NULL);
7034|                    xmlHaltParser(ctxt);
7035|                    goto error;
7036|                }
7037|                if (ctxt->input->id != id) {
7038|                    xmlFatalErrMsg(ctxt, XML_ERR_ENTITY_BOUNDARY,
7039|                                   "All markup of the conditional section is"
7040|                                   " not in the same entity\n");
7041|                }
7042|                NEXT;
7043|
7044|                while (PARSER_STOPPED(ctxt) == 0) {
7045|                    if (RAW == 0) {
7046|                        xmlFatalErr(ctxt, XML_ERR_CONDSEC_NOT_FINISHED, NULL);
7047|                        goto error;
7048|                    }
7049|                    if ((RAW == '<') && (NXT(1) == '!') && (NXT(2) == '[')) {
7050|                        SKIP(3);
7051|                        ignoreDepth++;
7052|                        /* Check for integer overflow */
7053|                        if (ignoreDepth == 0) {
7054|                            xmlErrMemory(ctxt);
7055|                            goto error;
7056|                        }
7057|                    } else if ((RAW == ']') && (NXT(1) == ']') &&
7058|                               (NXT(2) == '>')) {
7059|                        SKIP(3);
7060|                        if (ignoreDepth == 0)
7061|                            break;
7062|                        ignoreDepth--;
7063|                    } else {
7064|                        NEXT;
7065|                    }
7066|                }
7067|
7068|                if (ctxt->input->id != id) {
7069|                    xmlFatalErrMsg(ctxt, XML_ERR_ENTITY_BOUNDARY,
7070|                                   "All markup of the conditional section is"
7071|                                   " not in the same entity\n");
7072|                }
7073|            } else {
7074|                xmlFatalErr(ctxt, XML_ERR_CONDSEC_INVALID_KEYWORD, NULL);

7076|                goto error;
7077|            }
7078|        } else if ((depth > 0) &&
7079|                   (RAW == ']') && (NXT(1) == ']') && (NXT(2) == '>')) {
7080|            depth--;
7081|            if (ctxt->input->id != inputIds[depth]) {
7082|                xmlFatalErrMsg(ctxt, XML_ERR_ENTITY_BOUNDARY,
7083|                               "All markup of the conditional section is not"
7084|                               " in the same entity\n");

7119| * Parameter-entity replacement text must be properly nested with
7120| * markup declarations. That is to say, if either the first character
7121| * or the last character of a markup declaration (markupdecl above) is
7122| * contained in the replacement text for a parameter-entity reference,
7123| * both must be contained in the same replacement text.

7126| * In the internal DTD subset, parameter-entity references can occur
7127| * only where markup declarations can occur, not within markup declarations.

7129| * entities or to the external subset.)

7133|    GROW;

7137|	        case 'E':
7138|		    if (NXT(3) == 'L')

7140|		    else if (NXT(3) == 'N')
7141|			xmlParseEntityDecl(ctxt);

7143|                        SKIP(2);
7144|		    break;
7145|	        case 'A':
7146|		    xmlParseAttributeListDecl(ctxt);
7147|		    break;
7148|	        case 'N':
7149|		    xmlParseNotationDecl(ctxt);
7150|		    break;
7151|	        case '-':

7315|    xmlChar *val;

7321|     * Simple case of a CharRef

7324|	int i = 0;
7325|	xmlChar out[16];

7369|     * the parsing.
7370|     * Note: external parsed entities will not be loaded, it is not
7371|     * required for a non-validating parser, unless the parsing option

7373|     * far more secure as the parser will only process data coming from
7374|     * the document entity by default.

7376|     * FIXME: This doesn't work correctly since entities can be
7377|     * expanded with different namespace declarations in scope.
7378|     * For example:
7379|     *

7381|     *   <!ENTITY ent "<ns:elem/>">
7382|     * ]>
7383|     * <doc>
7384|     *   <decl1 xmlns:ns="urn:ns1">
7385|     *     &ent;
7386|     *   </decl1>
7387|     *   <decl2 xmlns:ns="urn:ns2">
7388|     *     &ent;
7389|     *   </decl2>

7394|     * - Ignore current namespace declarations when parsing the
7395|     *   entity. If a prefix can't be resolved, don't report an error
7396|     *   but mark it as unresolved.

7399|     *   which can also make use of the namespace hash table to avoid
7400|     *   quadratic behavior.

7403|     * expansion like we already do with custom SAX callbacks.
7404|     * External entity content should be cached in this case.
7405|     */

7407|        (((ctxt->options & XML_PARSE_NO_XXE) == 0) &&
7408|         ((ctxt->replaceEntities) ||

7415|             * build the entity content. Parse the entity again.
7416|             *
7417|             * This will also be triggered in normal tree builder mode
7418|             * if an entity happens to be empty, causing unnecessary
7419|             * reloads. It's hard to come up with a reliable check in

7428|     * They might be expanded later.

7432|
7433|    if (ctxt->replaceEntities == 0) {
7434|	/*

7441|        xmlNodePtr copy, cur;

7443|        /*

7446|        cur = ent->children;

7453|            }

7462|            /*

7464|             */

7466|            if (copy == NULL)

7469|            cur = cur->next;

7472|        /*
7473|         * This is to avoid a nasty side effect, see
7474|         * characters() in SAX.c

7477|        ctxt->nodelen = 0;
7478|    }

7481|static xmlEntityPtr
7482|xmlLookupGeneralEntity(xmlParserCtxtPtr ctxt, const xmlChar *name, int inAttr) {
7483|    xmlEntityPtr ent;
7484|
7485|    /*
7486|     * Predefined entities override any extra definition
7487|     */
7488|    if ((ctxt->options & XML_PARSE_OLDSAX) == 0) {
7489|        ent = xmlGetPredefinedEntity(name);
7490|        if (ent != NULL)
7491|            return(ent);
7492|    }
7493|
7494|    /*
7495|     * Ask first SAX for entity resolution, otherwise try the
7496|     * entities which may have stored in the parser context.
7497|     */
7498|    if (ctxt->sax != NULL) {
7499|	if (ctxt->sax->getEntity != NULL)
7500|	    ent = ctxt->sax->getEntity(ctxt->userData, name);
7501|	if ((ctxt->wellFormed == 1 ) && (ent == NULL) &&
7502|	    (ctxt->options & XML_PARSE_OLDSAX))
7503|	    ent = xmlGetPredefinedEntity(name);
7504|	if ((ctxt->wellFormed == 1 ) && (ent == NULL) &&
7505|	    (ctxt->userData==ctxt)) {
7506|	    ent = xmlSAX2GetEntity(ctxt, name);
7507|	}
7508|    }
7509|    /*
7510|     * [ WFC: Entity Declared ]
7511|     * In a document without any DTD, a document with only an
7512|     * internal DTD subset which contains no parameter entity
7513|     * references, or a document with "standalone='yes'", the
7514|     * Name given in the entity reference must match that in an
7515|     * entity declaration, except that well-formed documents
7516|     * need not declare any of the following entities: amp, lt,
7517|     * gt, apos, quot.
7518|     * The declaration of a parameter entity must precede any
7519|     * reference to it.
7520|     * Similarly, the declaration of a general entity must
7521|     * precede any reference to it which appears in a default
7522|     * value in an attribute-list declaration. Note that if
7523|     * entities are declared in the external subset or in
7524|     * external parameter entities, a non-validating processor
7525|     * is not obligated to read and process their declarations;
7526|     * for such documents, the rule that an entity must be
7527|     * declared is a well-formedness constraint only if
7528|     * standalone='yes'.
7529|     */
7530|    if (ent == NULL) {
7531|	if ((ctxt->standalone == 1) ||
7532|	    ((ctxt->hasExternalSubset == 0) &&
7533|	     (ctxt->hasPErefs == 0))) {
7534|	    xmlFatalErrMsgStr(ctxt, XML_ERR_UNDECLARED_ENTITY,
7535|		     "Entity '%s' not defined\n", name);
7536|	} else {
7537|	    xmlErrMsgStr(ctxt, XML_WAR_UNDECLARED_ENTITY,
7538|		     "Entity '%s' not defined\n", name);
7539|	    if ((ctxt->inSubset == 0) &&
7540|		(ctxt->sax != NULL) &&
7541|                (ctxt->disableSAX == 0) &&
7542|		(ctxt->sax->reference != NULL)) {
7543|		ctxt->sax->reference(ctxt->userData, name);
7544|	    }
7545|	}
7546|	ctxt->valid = 0;
7547|    }
7548|
7549|    /*
7550|     * [ WFC: Parsed Entity ]
7551|     * An entity reference must not contain the name of an
7552|     * unparsed entity
7553|     */
7554|    else if (ent->etype == XML_EXTERNAL_GENERAL_UNPARSED_ENTITY) {
7555|	xmlFatalErrMsgStr(ctxt, XML_ERR_UNPARSED_ENTITY,
7556|		 "Entity reference to unparsed entity %s\n", name);
7557|        ent = NULL;
7558|    }
7559|
7560|    /*
7561|     * [ WFC: No External Entity References ]
7562|     * Attribute values cannot contain direct or indirect
7563|     * entity references to external entities.
7564|     */
7565|    else if (ent->etype == XML_EXTERNAL_GENERAL_PARSED_ENTITY) {
7566|        if (inAttr) {
7567|            xmlFatalErrMsgStr(ctxt, XML_ERR_ENTITY_IS_EXTERNAL,
7568|                 "Attribute references external entity '%s'\n", name);
7569|            ent = NULL;
7570|        }
7571|    }
7572|
7573|    return(ent);
